prediction_text: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election: the contrarian reader who alone picked Trump as Republican nominee from a 17-candidate field follows through — Trump defeats Hillary Clinton on 8 November 2016 in an upset against the polls.
basis:
Card bears no tradition field; decided by genre: mundane/election astrology, single-reader track record (WP-005 setting differs from the panel card: this reader had earlier picked Trump as nominee when 17 Republicans contested).
A demonstrated early, specific, against-consensus hit on the nomination is weighted above the generic polling lead; the same reader's line is extended to the general election. This is the distinguishing fact on this card versus WP-004 and is stated as the basis for the opposite direction.
